SIKAFIBER® NOVOMESH®-950: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950, April 2023, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sikafiber_novomesh-950.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 is an engineered blend of macro and micro synthetic reinforcing fibres specifically designed for the reinforcement of concrete. SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 is 100% virgin copolymer polypropylene macro and micro fibres deisgned to provide the optimum combination of plastic shrinkage and long term reinforcement within the concrete. Specifically engineered and manufactured in an ISO 9001 certified manufacturing facility. SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 previously Novomesh 950 or SikaFiber Force 950.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Slabs-on-ground
    - Self consolidating concrete
    - Exterior pavements
    - Sidewalks/Driveways
    - Non-magnetic applications
    - Overlays & toppings
    - Drainage channels

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Blended Fibre - Macro Synthetic and Micro Synthetic
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Complies with European Standard EN 14889-2:2006 Fibres for Concrete Part 2: Class II and 1a. The fiber carries CE marking
    - Complies with ASTM C 1116/C 1116M,Type III fiber reinforced concrete
    - ISO 9001 Quality Assured Facility
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ISO 9001: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1); Description (p.1).
    - EN 14889-2:2006: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - ASTM C 1116: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Macro-synthetic/micro-synthetic fiber blend for secondary reinforcement
    - Inhibits formation of plastic shrinkage and plastic settlement cracks
    - Provides impact, abrasion and shatter resistance
    - Provides higher levels of residual strength
    - Provides improved durability and reduces permeability
    - Control of drying shrinkage and temperature cracking
    - Good finishing characteristics
    - Three dimensional reinforcement in concrete
    - Safer, quicker and easier to use than traditional reinforcement
    - Packaged for easy dosing into the concrete mix
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Density: 0.91 kg/l
2.6 Appearance and colour. Micro Synthetic:
    - Fiber Type: Monofilament micro synthetic fiber
    - Fiber Network: 48,500,000 fibres/kg
    - Fiber Type: Continuously deformed monofilament macro synthetic fiber
    - Fiber Network: 40,000 fibres/kg
    Macro Synthetic:
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: Micro Fiber: Length: Graded 12.7 & 19 mm. Diameter: Graded 0.03 & 0.05 mm. Aspect Ratio: Varies from 250 to 630; Length: 50 mm. Average Equivalent Diameter: 0.81 mm. Aspect Ratio: 62; Macro Fiber
    - Melting point: 164 °C
    - Resistance to alkalinity: Excellent
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: If stored in dry conditions shelf life is 5 years.
    - Storage conditions: SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 should be stored in a cool dry warehouse. Protect product from the rain and direct sunlight.
2.9 Packaging. SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 fibres are available in boxes containing 5 degradable bags 2.27 kg each, 27 boxes per pallet. The macro monofilament fibre is collated in water soluble wrapped bundles (pucks) within the degradable bag for rapid distribution.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. The dosage of the SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 will vary according to the type of application and the performance requirements of the project. Standard recommended dosage rate of SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 is between 1 and 3 bags/m³ of concrete. Dosages outside the recommended dosage range can be used to meet project specific requirements. If this is the case please contact your Sika representative for technical support
4.3 Dispensing. SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 in a dispersible bag can be added directly to the concrete mixing system after the batching of the ingredients and mixed for 4 to 5 minutes or 70 revolutions. The addition of SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 at the recommended dosage rates may decrease the slump; however, additional water should not be added. Only a water reducing or high range water reducing admixture should be used to adjust concrete to the desired workability. Application; The addition of SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 at the normal recommended dosage rate does not require any mix design or application changes. The fiber concrete can be mixed, sprayed or placed using conventional equipment. Tooling & Finishing; SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950 can be used in power/hand troweled concrete, colored and broom finished concrete. Fiber reinforced concrete can be finished by most finishing techniques as indicated in ACI-302. Proper timing and workmanship are important when using a macro synthetic fiber to insure fiber is not elevated at the surface.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaFiber® Novomesh®-950, April 2023, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sikafiber_novomesh-950.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaFiber Novomesh, version 30/07/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/SikaFiber%C2%AE%20Novomesh%C2%AE%20GHS%207.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Polypropylene-based macro and blended fibres, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/epd-polypropylene-basedmacroandblendedfibres.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
